Families have the opportunity to socialize while children develop new skills in an early learning environment. This program is offered in partnership with the Malvern Family Resource Centre (MFRC) . This is a drop-in program. No registration required.

events.title: Baby Time
events.description: Bouncing and tickling rhymes, stories, and songs for babies from birth to 18 months with their parents or caregivers.  Drop-in, no registration is required. Space is limited.

events.title: Family Time
events.description: Join us for rhymes, songs and stories for children from 0-5, with their parents or caregivers. A fun activity, game or craft to follow. Children, parents and caregivers are invited to Stay and Play.

events.title: EarlyON Music and Movement
events.description: Join EarlyON for a weekly Music & Movement program designed for families with children from birth to 6 years. Enjoy interactive songs, stories, finger rhymes, movement, and social time in a welcoming environment. Drop-in, no registration required.

events.title: Family Time
events.description: Join us for stories, songs and fun activities. After the program, families are invited to stay and socialize or make a craft. This program is for children ages 0-5 years and their parents or caregivers.

events.title: Family Time
events.description: Join us for stories, songs, rhymes and activities in this program for children ages 5 and under and their parents or caregivers. Family Time runs from 10:30 to 11:30 am. Drop in. No registration required, but space is limited.

events.title: Family Time
events.description: Join us for stories, songs, rhymes and activities in this program for children ages 5 and under and their parents or caregivers. Family Time runs from 10:30 to 11:00 am. Children, parents and caregivers are invited to Stay and Play, from 11:00 to 11:30.  Drop-in. Space is limited.

Activities change each week, so there’s always something new to explore!
